issues.description: conanfile.py lacks the mandatory file header (shebang + docstring naming software and build system). The file starts directly with `from conan import ConanFile`. The same convention is followed repo-wide (e.g. archives/z/zlib/1.3.1/conanfile.py).
issues.fix_suggestion: Prepend a shebang and a one-line docstring.

issues.description: Class RakuLogConan declares no `package_type` attribute. code_style forbids leaving `package_type` empty/wrong (library="library", tool="application"). This is a pure Raku module package, so it should be `library`.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add `package_type = "library"` next to the other class attributes.

issues.description: Method order deviates from the documented sequence. `layout()` precedes `requirements()`.
issues.fix_suggestion: Move `requirements()` above `layout()`; order of `validate()` is not enforced.

summary: PASS (P0=0, P1=0). raku-log 0.3.1 is a pure Raku (6.d) source-copy package run via the published rakudo/2025.11 OHOS runtime. No deception: the test package really executes Raku code with executed assertions against the packaged API. R26 is N/A for an interpreted module; R38 commands.json is correctly absent. W2 atomicity holds. MANIFEST.yml / manifest.yaml / test-report.md are mutually consistent (11 assertions). Only non-blocking code-style gaps remain (conanfile header, package_type, method order).
